Files in this folder are third-party open-source software, copied unchanged from npm packages (nothing is modified).  The two big files
are stored gzip-compressed (`gzip -9`; unpacking gives back the npm file with the SHA-256 below) as transformers.min.js.gz and
ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm.gz; regal.py serves them under their original names with Content-Encoding gzip.

  transformers.min.js
      @huggingface/transformers 4.3.0 (npm, dist/transformers.min.js), Apache License 2.0, see LICENSE-transformers.js.txt
      https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
      (this file contains ONNX Runtime Web 1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0, MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation)

  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.mjs, ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm (kept here as ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm.gz)
      onnxruntime-web 1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0 (npm, dist/), MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation
      https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

They run the AI model in the visitor's browser (see static/js/regal-chat-worker.js).  The page loads them from this server, never
from a CDN.  SHA-256:

  1475fd440e9932ab206682ee42cb18f6097403e9ee77ea62084c592d0f83597d  transformers.min.js
  0966b6105cd936744498aa60df7a22cbd47af3374dbc64a9ab561c08a71e3611  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.mjs
  49871f5a4409519797e127440868a6d1923339d9185907f301a5b2a1d90af082  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm
